## writeAttestationsSync() function

Write attestations file to disk (sync).

Creates parent directories if needed. The signature should be computed separately and passed in.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function writeAttestationsSync(filePath: string, attestations: Attestation[], signature: string): void;
```
